Description: "Update last candle copyWith in CandleSeries dataSource to adjust high and low limits dynamically based on the live close price, ensuring valid candlestick structure for Syncfusion."
Instruction: "Update the last candle copyWith in CandleSeries dataSource."
TargetContent:
"            dataSource: candles.isEmpty ? [] : [
              ...candles.sublist(0, candles.length - 1),
              candles.last.copyWith(
                close: _animatedCloseNotifier.value == 0 
                    ? candles.last.close 
                    : _animatedCloseNotifier.value
              ),
            ],"
